jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: build
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; ENGINE_DIR=experimental/duck_cuda; if [ -x "$ENGINE_DIR/build_remote.sh" ]; then (cd "$ENGINE_DIR" && ./build_remote.sh) 2>&1 | tee build.log; elif [ -f "$ENGINE_DIR/CMakeLists.txt" ]; then cmake -S "$ENGINE_DIR" -B build_cuda -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120 2>&1 | tee build.log && cmake --build build_cuda -j4 2>&1 | tee -a build.log; else echo "PLACEHOLDER: $ENGINE_DIR has no build_remote.sh or CMakeLists.txt yet (engine not landed); nothing to build" | tee build.log; fi

jobs.name: smoke-test
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; TEST_BIN=$(find build_cuda experimental/duck_cuda -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm -u+x \( -name 'test_*' -o -name '*_test' \) 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$TEST_BIN" ]; then echo "running $TEST_BIN" | tee smoke.log && "$TEST_BIN" 2>&1 | tee -a smoke.log; else echo 'PLACEHOLDER: no test binary found (adjust once the engine lands)' | tee smoke.log; fi
